messages:
ashley: FYI: sudden GPU attach backlog in us-central1 starting ~04:40 UTC — ~45 attach failures in the last 20m. Nodes report local NVMe IOPS saturation and a bunch of orphaned 0-byte tempfiles under /tmp/scratch.

devops-bot: [ALERT] nvme-iops-spike on gnode-usc1-* (detected 04:41:02 UTC) :warning:

omar: any scheduled janitor/cleanup windows? looks like small-file delete storm can blow up iops and trigger firmware retry loops.

ashley: janitor ran at 04:38 (global cadence), plus we had a per-region metadata sync starting 04:35. attaching quick dmesg + iostat excerpt: 
```
04:40:57 kernel: nvme0: qpair 2 timeout, aborting command
04:41:01 kernel: nvme nvme0: controller error, status=0x40000003
04:41:05 iostat -x 1 3
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s  r/s  w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await
nvme0n1         0.00   0.00  2.00 1200.00  16.00  240.00  0.20  45.60  37.2
```

rachel: OS reported wear-level alerts on ~8 nodes last week; firmware vendor noted higher retry rates post scrub-firmware. Could be a confluence: janitor small writes + rebalance metadata churn + firmware retry escalates latency -> kernel hard remount to RO in a few cases.

pete: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause janitor in us-central nodepools (kubectl scale deployment janitor --replicas=0 -n infra-usc1) 2) cordon + drain the worst hosts and repro in staging 3) delay metadata rebalance. Anyone can run the pause now?

ashley: paused janitor on usc1-pool-a at 04:47. cordoning 3 hosts with highest nvme latency.

devops-bot: action recorded: user ashley paused janitor on infra-usc1 at 04:47:12 UTC.

omar: also lower trim cadence and reduce fstrim concurrency for the region while triaging. Slight perf hit but fewer small synchronous writes.

storage-bot: Storage note: vendor recommends reducing scrub_concurrency to 1 for affected firmware families and capturing nvme-cli telemetry: `nvme telemetry-log --log-id=0x03` and `nvme error-log`. Also capture SMART reallocated_sector_count.

rachel: customer impact: some preemptible jobs failed to provision -> autoscaler spun up more replacements in other regions, bumping short-term spend. We should include cost hit estimate in RCA.

pete: agree. I'll flag infra-costs and set alert to pause global janitor if region attach failures > 20 in 15m. That should prevent cross-region ripples.

ashley: after pausing janitor + cordon/drain, attach rate recovered to expected in ~12m. 42/45 attaches retried successfully. Leaving nodes in maintenance until we have firmware + janitor cadence changes validated. Filing follow-up ticket and scheduling a staged repro in usc1-staging for next Tuesday.

storage-bot: Suggested RCA checklist: 1) reproduce small-delete + overlayfs lowerdir swap in staging 2) capture nvme error logs + SMART + nvme-cli retry stats 3) test scrub_concurrency=1/2 4) validate janitor backoff settings (rate-limit deletes) 5) run cost simulation for attach-backlog-induced cross-region autoscale.

omar: thanks, keep me looped. I'll help with the staged repro and metric dashboards for latency thresholds. :eyes:
